6.106 rsInvalidSeriesGrouping
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
rsInvalidSeriesGrouping is a critical error that will occur when a SeriesGrouping element contains
neither or both of the following elements: SeriesGrouping.StaticSeries and
SeriesGrouping.DynamicSeries.
